metadata.description: A Salesforce-first workspace: plain-English assistants for your deals, accounts, contacts, leads, cases, and to-dos. One plugin per common object, each bundling skills, dashboards, and the Salesforce MCP server.

plugins.name: astound-commons
plugins.description: First-run workspace setup (installs the Salesforce dashboards into your Artifacts library) plus shared brand skills: voice, document formatting, client email, company boilerplate, and terminology

plugins.name: astound-admin
plugins.description: Admin-only control plane: who is using the platform, what it costs, what failed, and why. Ships the systemprompt CLI server plus governance, analytics, and operations skills, and three live dashboards.

plugins.name: astound-salesforce
plugins.description: Your Salesforce assistant: what it can do, and how to ask in plain English across deals, accounts, contacts, leads, cases, and tasks

plugins.name: astound-dev
plugins.description: Astound's development workflow for Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Storefront Next projects: plan (open spec & architecture), build (Storefront Next conventions), release (commits & PRs), and test (Playwright verification)

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-opportunities
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce opportunities: find deals, read your pipeline and forecast, and safely create and update deals

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-accounts
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce accounts: find customers, get a 360° briefing before a call, and safely create and update account records

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-contacts
plugins.description: Work with the people in your Salesforce: find contacts, get briefed on who you know at an account, and safely create and update contact records

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-leads
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce leads: find and filter prospects, read your funnel insights, and safely capture and update leads

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-cases
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce support cases: find cases, read your queue and backlog, and safely create and update cases

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-activities
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce activities: find what's due and overdue, read your day and week at a glance, and safely log calls, set follow-ups, and schedule meetings
